name: cuid---uuid
title: CUID <—> UUID Converter
description: Transforms CUIDs into UUIDs and vice versa
author: michal_noszczak

commands.name: cuids---uuids
commands.title: CUIDs -> UUIDs
commands.description: Convert CUIDs to UUIDs from selected text or clipboard

commands.name: uuid---cuid
commands.title: UUID -> CUID
commands.description: Convert nil UUIDs (version 0) to CUIDs from selected text or clipboard

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
